detailed_description: Text Deduplicator removes duplicate lines from pasted text directly in the browser. Paste one item or line per row, then use the Case Sensitive and Trim Lines checkboxes to control how duplicates are compared. The output updates on the page and keeps the first matching line that appears in the input. Summary counters show original lines, unique lines, and removed duplicates, and the Copy button copies the deduplicated output.
usage_steps: Paste text into the input textarea with each item on its own line.
Toggle Case Sensitive depending on whether different letter casing should count as unique.
Toggle Trim Lines depending on whether leading and trailing spaces should be ignored for matching.
Review the original, unique, and removed line counts.
Check the output textarea and copy the deduplicated result when needed.
usage_examples: Clean a short list of email addresses before copying it into another tool.
Remove repeated names from a pasted attendee or contributor list.
Deduplicate copied log lines while keeping the first occurrence.
Compare case-sensitive and case-insensitive cleanup for a list of tags.
